meta.title: Pokémon Mass Battle: how many Magikarp beat Arceus?
meta.description: Thousands of Pokémon clash on a 3D battlefield, with the real games' damage maths for every hit. How many Magikarp does it take to beat Arceus? Ask any matchup, or send two armies at each other, then make a video of it.
meta.questionDescription: {title} The real games' battle maths decide it, thousands of battles deep, then you watch it in 3D.
meta.battleDescription: {title}: a Pokémon mass battle in 3D with the real games' damage maths. Who wins?
meta.presetDescription: {blurb} A Pokémon mass battle in 3D with the real games' damage maths.

name: Pokémon Mass Battle
blurb: Thousands of Pokémon clash on a 3D battlefield, and every hit uses the real games' damage maths. Ask how many of one Pokémon it takes to beat another, or send two armies at each other.

summary.pure: Pure battle maths, with everyone in reach of everyone: {answer}.

magikarp-vs-arceus.title: How many Magikarp beat Arceus?
magikarp-vs-arceus.hook: How many Magikarp does it take to beat Arceus? 😳
magikarp-vs-arceus.blurb: The weakest Pokémon against the one said to have shaped the universe. The solver finds the smallest army that wins.

rattata-vs-mewtwo.title: 1,000 Rattata vs 1 Mewtwo
rattata-vs-mewtwo.blurb: A thousand of the commonest Pokémon in Kanto against its most powerful one.

pikachu-vs-snorlax.title: 100 Pikachu vs 1 Snorlax
pikachu-vs-snorlax.blurb: A wave of Pikachu against the heaviest wall in Kanto.

kanto-starters.title: Kanto starters war
kanto-starters.hook: 600 Kanto starters vs their final evolutions 🔥💧🌿
kanto-starters.blurb: Bulbasaur, Charmander and Squirtle in their hundreds against a few dozen Venusaur, Charizard and Blastoise.

fire-vs-water.title: Fire vs Water
fire-vs-water.hook: Every Fire type vs every Water type 🔥🌊
fire-vs-water.blurb: Every fully evolved Fire type against every fully evolved Water type: the oldest matchup in Pokémon, at scale.

legendaries-vs-everyone.title: Legendaries vs everyone
legendaries-vs-everyone.hook: Every legendary Pokémon vs an army of Kanto 👑
legendaries-vs-everyone.blurb: Every legendary Pokémon against ten of every other fully evolved Pokémon from Kanto.

bug-swarm-vs-charizard.title: Bug swarm vs one Charizard
bug-swarm-vs-charizard.blurb: Beedrill, Butterfree, Venomoth and Scyther swarm a Charizard that is super effective against every one of them.

eeveelution-civil-war.title: Eeveelution civil war
eeveelution-civil-war.hook: Eeveelution civil war: which half wins? 🦊
eeveelution-civil-war.blurb: Vaporeon, Jolteon, Flareon and Espeon against Umbreon, Leafeon, Glaceon and Sylveon.

fire-vs-water-sun.title: Fire vs Water in harsh sunlight
fire-vs-water-sun.hook: Fire vs Water… but the sun is out ☀️
fire-vs-water-sun.blurb: The same armies as Fire vs Water, under harsh sunlight: Fire moves hit 1.5× harder and Water moves half as hard, as in the games.

light-ball-pikachu-vs-snorlax.title: How many Pikachu with a Light Ball beat Snorlax?
light-ball-pikachu-vs-snorlax.hook: How many Pikachu does it take to beat Snorlax… with a Light Ball? ⚡
light-ball-pikachu-vs-snorlax.blurb: Pikachu's own held item doubles its Attack and Special Attack. Every Pikachu holds one; Snorlax holds nothing.
